refreshToken.description: The opaque refresh token from the last `TokenPair`.

externalLink.description: Absolute `http(s)://` URL, ≤ 500 chars; empty after trimming → `null`.

projectLeadUserId.description: A registered user as the lead; excludes `projectLeadName`.

name.description: `user.displayName` for a user lead, else the saved text name.

dueDate.description: Work date in `YYYY-MM-DD`; empty after trimming → `null`.

totalMinutes.description: The sum of all the day's logs, excluded ones too.

startMinute.description: Minutes after midnight: 0–1425, a multiple of 15.

totalMinutes.description: Minutes of all the matching logs, not only this page.

bookedMinutes.description: Minutes of the matching logs that have a booking date.

workDate.description: The work date, `YYYY-MM-DD`; not after today.

dayStartMinute.description: The day's start when the date has no workday yet: 0–1425, a multiple of 15.

workDate.description: Moves the log to this date; not `null`, not after today.

title.description: ≤ 100 chars; empty after trimming or `null` clears it.

dayStartMinute.description: The start of the target date when it has no workday yet.

logIds.description: 1–100 time log ids; repeats are allowed.

bookingDate.description: A date not after today in the caller's zone, or `null` to remove the booking. Absent → 400.

startMinute.description: Minutes after midnight, or `null` for a date with logs but no workday.

project.description: The project `Ref` (a deleted project → its retained name, `deleted: true`); `null` for `unsorted` and `nonprod`.

password.description: 1–200 chars. Omitted = keep the stored password.

confirmAccountSwitch.description: Confirms a switch to another PMSPA account (FR-INT-002).

lead.description: Project: its lead's name, "" when none.

pm4.description: Null when the side has no value.

groupId.description: For a task: its project on the same side.

detail.description: What tells it apart from the row's record, e.g. "Lead Jane Doe".

direction.description: Where a project or task is written (OQ-172). Null for days, events and undecided differs rows.

linkedId.description: The linked counterpart's id on the other side, or null.

overwrite.description: `link`: the side to overwrite; null = Link only.

id.description: `link`: the record to pair with (a picked candidate, or the linked counterpart).

newTitle.description: The title after an overwrite changed it (shown as "old → new", OQ-174).
